You were taught to be a hunter and a raider. You are trained with @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.dUC8Fsa6FZtVikS3]{Composite Longbows}, @Compendium[pathfinders-guide-to-eberron.eberron-items.Eresc1MTy0Q4M8fL]{Gnoll bows}, @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.t5FbyZtRL4qV0V7k]{Flails}, @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.YLb6XnT7OxAVGL5m]{Khopesh}, @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.MeA0g9xvWCbGxf2g]{Mambele}, @Compendium[pathfinders-guide-to-eberron.eberron-items.8nZhO0w0xuNXUk5X]{Myrnaxes}, @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.tOhoGvmCMw4JpWcS]{Spears}, and @Compendium[pf2e.equipment-srd.mVxA9E2ernBL6fM6]{War Flails}.

 

In addition, you gain access to all uncommon Gnoll weapons. For the purpose of determining your proficiency, martial gnoll weapons are simple weapons and advanced gnoll weapons are martial weapons.

source.value: Pathfinder Lost Omens: The Mwangi Expanse
